REVIEWED 2026-10-25 (TodoReview) against origin/develop 9a184b619 and fork main ea44bcc9 (30.24.0.13). PROBLEM
After #3379 (merged 2026-10-24) benchbox/core/platform_manifest.py is the single platform-to-dialect home. Athena and SingleStore declare a native `sql_dialect` but keep a different `query_dialect` because benchmark code keys behaviour on the old names. Native dialects would give SingleStore `:>` casts and NULLS FIRST and Athena its own dialect. This is an owner decision with possible follow-up work.

VERIFIED FACTS (2026-10-25)
- Manifest (develop): singlestore `sql_dialect: singlestore`, `query_dialect: mysql`; athena `sql_dialect: athena`, `query_dialect: trino`. benchbox/platforms/athena.py and singlestore.py read it through `get_platform_query_dialect`. The manifest validator requires query_dialect to differ from sql_dialect.
- No published Athena or SingleStore bundle exists in results-data (367 manifests searched recursively), so 'flag affected published bundles' is empty today; neither platform has a real engine in fork CI (SingleStore is a documented gap row in the fork's downstream/ENGINE-GAPS.md; Athena has none).
- Which behaviours are keyed on `trino`/`mysql` (LIST_AGGREGATE_DIALECTS-style dispatch, keyed rewrites, lock-bypass rules) has not been inventoried; the item text asserted it without a list.

DECISION GATES (stop and ask the owner)
G1 Retarget? Options: (a) keep trino/mysql (recommended default: no published bundle, no engine to prove the change, low value now); (b) retarget SingleStore only; (c) retarget both. 
G2 If (b)/(c): cloud validation. SingleStore Helios and Athena/AWS checks cost money: owner approval before any live run; otherwise documented gap + golden-output tests only.
G3 Dialect retargeting also changes translation for every benchmark on that platform: owner approves the corpus diff before merge.

GUARDRAILS
- Keep the manifest the single home; no second dialect table, no aliases or shims; every caller migrated or the change is not made.
- Do not start implementation until G1 is answered; if G1(a), only record the decision and close.
- No cloud spend; no edits to published bundles.

TRANSLATION-CHANGE CHECKS (any BenchBox PR that changes emitted SQL): `make sql-execution-gate`, `make compat-docs-check`, `make typecheck`, `make comment-policy-check`, `BENCHBOX_QUESTDB_DSN=postgresql://admin:quest@127.0.0.1:8812/qdb make sqlglot-repro-retirement-check`. SQL translation fixes land in the fork BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot (clone /Users/joe/Developer/sqlglot) with a real-engine test in fork CI or a documented gap in downstream/ENGINE-GAPS.md; BenchBox adopts via a wheel-bump PR carrying `make sqlglot-fork-diff` output.
STANDING GUARDRAILS: work only in a `make worktree-create` worktree after `make agent-write-preflight` (primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox is read-only); run tests only through make targets (`make test-fast`, `make pr-preflight`, `make sql-execution-gate`, `make tpcds-obt-equivalence`) or targeted `uv run -- python -m pytest <paths> -n 4`; never BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR, `make test-unlock` or raw broad runs; one heavy run at a time; no live-cloud spend and no production publish without explicit owner approval; published result bundles are never edited (only manifest-sidecar `known_defects` and results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md per results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md); no SKIP / --no-verify / `git add -A`; no explanatory comments or docstrings in code (`make comment-policy-check`); uv only; identity Joe Harris, no Co-Authored-By; PR flow `make pr-preflight` once, `make pr-open`, CI + oracle review, `make pr-arm`. Stop and ask the owner on unexpected result changes, relaxed guards, oracle stand-ins or real design choices.
